# Pinned local MODNet portrait matting

Model: [Xenova/modnet](https://huggingface.co/Xenova/modnet/tree/fa2fa546052fba4c08921230a26cc69a333fca12), revision `fa2fa546052fba4c08921230a26cc69a333fca12`. The pinned model card declares Apache-2.0. Original [MODNet project license](https://github.com/ZHKKKe/MODNet/blob/master/LICENSE) is Apache-2.0; its redistribution grant requires license/attribution retention. MODEL-CARD.md and MODNet-LICENSE are retained unmodified. The ONNX conversion is distributed by Xenova; original model is by ZHKKKe/MODNet contributors. This project does not claim ownership of either.

The fp32 weights are 25,888,640 bytes, SHA256 `07c308cf0fc7e6e8b2065a12ed7fc07e1de8febb7dc7839d7b7f15dd66584df9`, verified against the pinned Hugging Face LFS metadata and again before each inference. config.json and preprocessor_config.json are pinned alongside the weights. Model/config/card/license downloads total under 26 MB, below the authorized 200 MiB cap. No runtime inference connects to Hugging Face.

The existing local ONNX Runtime Web `1.31.0-dev.20260914-8d85527a0` WASM-only JS and single-thread runtime come from retained Luma's installed/runtime assets; MIT license is retained. manifest.json records exact artifact hashes/sizes. There are no model/runtime alterations; the new Hole worker is an independent adapter corresponding to Luma's `neuralMatte` pipeline: shortest-edge512 RGB bilinear resize, floor-to32 dimensions, rescale1/255, mean/std0.5, real MODNet `input` tensor and soft alpha output. The transparent PNG multiplies original source alpha by model alpha.

Host: `HoleCutout.run(blob,{signal,onProgress,timeoutMs})`; no storage authority. Dedicated module worker, one job at a time, timeout at most90seconds, worker terminated on cancellation, deadline, error and success. PNG/JPEG/WebP only,30MiB input cap, decoded dimensions at most2048 each, aspect ratio at most4:1. Oversized dimensions are rejected, never silently resized. Browser image decode allocates before decoded dimensions are available; this is not a hard browser-process memory cap. Worker termination is a job lifetime bound.

Required root CSP: worker-src 'self', script-src includes 'wasm-unsafe-eval' (not unsafe-eval), existing connect-src self. Recommended worker response CSP: `default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; connect-src 'self'`. All imports/model/WASM addresses are fixed same-origin relative URLs. No CDN wildcard, cross-origin model fetch, SharedArrayBuffer, native server, uploaded image or paid service is involved.

Acceptance uses a deterministic synthetic head-and-shoulders fixture. It establishes actual inference, nontrivial soft alpha, exact opaque RGB retention, alpha-mask agreement, dimension retention and terminate-on-cancel/deadline. It is not a portrait-quality benchmark; MODNet is optimized for portraits and may misclassify other subjects, fine hair or backgrounds. Action integration must record the immutable source/model identity and abort-check before atomic output commit. Existing originals remain in Hole.
